units.text: INT. ER TRAUMA BAY - NIGHT
A curtained bay under harsh fluorescent light.
Monitors beep in a staggered chorus.
The floor is wet where something was mopped and then spilled again.
On the gurney lies a motorcyclist in a ruined leather jacket, jaw clamped around a bite block.
Round him, the team works in a tight ring.
DR. FATIMA HADDAD (40s, trauma lead, surgical cap with cartoon owls) calls out numbers in a flat voice.
DR. PIERRE LEFEBVRE-OKORO (30s, resident, shirt soaked to the elbow) holds pressure on the chest.
NURSE TALIA BRODERICK (50s, silver braid, expert hands) pushes a syringe into a line and calls the drug.
RESPIRATORY THERAPIST GUNNAR EKSTROM (20s, headset, calm) squeezes a bag and watches the numbers climb.
Two of epi in.
units.name: TALIA

units.text: Pressure?
units.name: FATIMA

units.text: Seventy over forty.
units.name: GUNNAR

units.text: I have the bleed. I have it.
units.name: PIERRE

units.text: Hold it. Hold it, Pierre.
units.name: FATIMA

units.text: Holding.
units.name: PIERRE

units.text: The monitor tone changes: a faster beep, a ragged line.
Fatima lifts her eyes to it.
Nobody speaks.
Gunnar squeezes the bag.
Talia's hand rests on the patient's shoulder, steady as a stone.
Eighty over fifty. Ninety.
units.name: GUNNAR

units.text: Sinus rhythm. We have a rhythm.
units.name: FATIMA

units.text: The tone smooths.
A long breath moves around the ring like a wave.
Pierre's shoulders drop an inch.
Talia taps the shoulder twice, lightly, the way you would pat a horse.
The curtain flicks open.
A tall man steps through: DR. EMEKA ADEYEMI-STROM (60s, chief of surgery, tie loose, tired).
He takes in the monitors, the blood, the faces, and nods once.
OR two is ready. Who's going up?
units.name: EMEKA

units.text: Pierre will scrub in with you. I'll stay with the chest tube.
units.name: FATIMA

units.text: Good.
units.name: EMEKA

units.text: Good?
units.name: PIERRE

units.text: Good work. All of you.
units.name: EMEKA

units.text: He doesn't smile.
He doesn't have to.
The room has just slowed down to a human speed, and the owls on Fatima's cap seem to blink.
Gurney. On three.
units.name: TALIA

units.text: They count it together and roll him out.
FADE OUT.
